verdict.rationale: Convex's CLI docs state that when you change a function or the schema, the dev watcher pushes the change and automatically updates the generated types in convex/_generated. The marketing site also claims end-to-end type safety, so automatic TypeScript type generation from the schema is a documented first-party capability. Missing for 10: detail on what the generated code contains (e.g. typed document/ID types or a typed client API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
